question: What baselines do they compare with?

answer.free_form_answer: They compare with the following models: by Pedersen (2017), by Pramanick and Das (2017), by Mikhalkova and Karyakin (2017),  by Vadehra (2017), Indurthi and Oota (2017), by Vechtomova (2017), by (Cai et al., 2018), and CRF.

title: Joint Detection and Location of English Puns
answer_rationale: The document explicitly states in Text 1 that they implemented a baseline model based on conditional random fields (CRF) and compared their model's performance against this baseline, noting significantly higher recall compared to CRF.
